subject: NorthStar Data renewal + 18mo capacity uplift — draft redlines and signpath
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@northstardata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NorthStar Data renewal + capacity uplift — initial draft

Hi Maya,

Per our call this morning, attached is the renewal package with the proposed 18-month term and the capacity uplift reflected in Exhibit B. Key points for your review:

- Term: shift from 12 months to 18 months (pricing tier adjusted in Exhibit B).
- Capacity: +40% committed token capacity for the first 12 months, with burst buffer described on p.2.
- SAML + KMS: we noted NorthStar's KMS requirement in Section 7 (customer-managed keys) and SAML in the Appendix; those are implementation notes, not gating for signature.
- SLAs: latency target unchanged; we've proposed a 30% credit for repeat SLA misses (see SLA schedule).

Can you confirm whether the KMS language is acceptable or whether your legal team will request alternate wording? Also looping legal (Aditya) and ops (Grace) to keep the review tight.

Files attached: NSD_Renewal_Draft_20280711_redlined.docx, OrderForm_ExhibitB_v3.pdf (attachment: NSD_Renewal_Draft_20280711_redlined.docx)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@northstardata.com>

Cc: Procurement <procure@northstardata.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Data renewal + capacity uplift — initial draft

Laura —

Thanks for the draft and the quick turnaround. A few initial procurement/legal asks from our side:

- Term: NorthStar prefers an 18-month term with an option to extend for an additional 6 months at the same rates; can you mark that as an optional extension in Section 2?
- Liability cap: our legal team will push for a higher cap for data-related incidents (proposing 2x fees instead of the current 1x).
- Data handling: need explicit language that Redwood will not use customer data for model training; suggest a clause in Section 5.

I attached an internal procurement checklist with items they flagged (attachment: NSD_Procurement_Checklist_20280712.pdf). Can Aditya and Redwood legal review liability and the no-training language and come back with redlines?

Also, procurement would like DocuSign-ready docs once legal signs off — we can turn that around quickly.

—Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Cloud Procurement | NorthStar Data
maya.singh@northstardata.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-07-12T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Data renewal + capacity uplift — initial draft

Laura/Maya/Aditya —

Quick commercial note from our side: the optional 6-month extension at the same rates is fine, but if legal accepts the 2x liability cap for data incidents we should add a modest premium — thinking a one-time implementation fee of $25k or a 3% uplift on the first 6 months of committed spend.

Aditya — please advise whether Redwood legal can accept the \"no-training\" clause as a standalone warranty or if we should scope it as a contractual data use limitation with auditing rights.

Grace — ops to confirm whether the KMS approach in Section 7 needs any implementation lead-time notes.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@northstardata.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-13T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Data renewal + capacity uplift — legal redlines attached

Hi all,

Attached is Redwood's legal redline to the MSA and Order Form (attachment: Aditya_MSARedline_20280713.docx). High-level notes:

1) No-training clause — we can accept a contractual prohibition on using NorthStar data to update public model weights. Suggested wording: \"Customer Data will not be used to train or improve Redwood's public models; customer may opt-in to controlled research uses with explicit written consent.\" This preserves future options and addresses their ask.

2) Liability cap — we cannot move to an uncapped position; however, for data-specific incidents tied to breach of security commitments, we can increase the cap to 2x fees for incidents attributable to our negligence and limited to direct damages. We added narrow carve-outs (see §11.3).

3) KMS / SAML — added implementation timeline language (30-60 days) and a handover plan in Appendix A. Ops will need to confirm exact provisioning steps.

4) DocuSign / execution — once commercial items (extension option + premium) are agreed, we will produce a DocuSign envelope.

Please review the redline and call out any items you want tightened/relaxed; happy to jump on a short legal-commercial sync if needed.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
(415) 555-0157

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@northstardata.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@northstardata.com>, NorthStar Data, Legal <legal@northstardata.com>
Date: 2028-07-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Data renewal + capacity uplift — legal redlines attached

Aditya — thanks for the fast turnaround and the compromise language. Our legal team reviewed the redline and is broadly comfortable with the proposed 2x cap tied to negligence and direct damages. They asked for two minor clarifications:

- Add a definition for "Customer Data breach" that references unauthorized access, exfiltration, or disclosure.
- Confirm that the no-training clause applies only to models that Redwood distributes publicly (not private models run for NorthStar workloads).

If you can add those two clarifications we can move to DocuSign. Procurement is standing by to finalize the commercial uplift as discussed.

—Maya

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: NorthStar Data renewal + capacity uplift — next steps and signpath

Great — thanks everyone. Aditya, can you fold Maya's two clarifications into a final redline and attach the DocuSign-ready package? Ben/Grace, I'll confirm the one-time $25k implementation fee in the order form and send the final HubSpot deal update.

Action items:
- Aditya: final redline + DocuSign envelope (due EOD 2028-07-16).
- Ben: confirm commercial uplift and update HS-89321.
- Grace: ops to schedule a 30-day kickoff for KMS provision and SAML test window.

I'll send the DocuSign link to Maya and procurement once Aditya confirms.

Thanks — Laura
